newsitem.title: UK: GKN Westland wins civil order for EH101-paper.
newsitem.headline: GKN Westland wins civil order for EH101-paper.

text.p: British group GKN Plc's helicopter manufacturing subsidiary Westland Group has won the first order for a civilian version of the Anglo-Italian EH101, the Financial Times said on Monday.
The report said that it was believed that Westland has sold a variant of the naval helicopter to Tokyo's Metropolitan Police Agency for an estimated $28 million.
It said GKN would only confirm that it had concluded a civil sale in the Far East.
But the paper said Westland officials also confirmed that the group had signed off a long-awaited Italian order for 16 naval versions of the aircraft worth 450 million pounds.
It said Westland's Italian partner, Finmeccanica SFI.MI unit Agusta, would get about 300 million pounds of the total, leaving Westland with the balance, with first deliveries expected in early 1998.
